newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak cbank sets three-day repo, min rate 8.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak cbank sets three-day repo, min rate 8.8 pct.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) on Friday set a three-day repo tender to add market liquidity of a maximum 1.0 billion crowns.
Minimum rate in the tender was set at 8.8 percent, equal to the discount rate, a central bank statement said.
The NBS added 1.0 billion crowns through a one-week repo tender on Thursday, with average yield rising to 19.50 percent from 9.38 percent in a similar repo on Tuesday.
The central bank monitors market liquidity on a daily basis and decides each morning whether to hold any open market operations.
According to NBS figures, the Slovak banking sector as of July 17 lacked 5.53 percent of the funds needed to meet minimum reserves requirements on July 31.
